historical_territory: Các hoạt động ghi nhận và xác thực trong Late Uruk: con người/role xử lý quantity và authentication bằng counters, clay envelopes, sealings và numerical surfaces; trong cùng ecology đó, information ngày càng có thể nằm trực tiếp trên durable clay surfaces trong khi older practices vẫn cùng tồn tại.

historical_change.from: Quantity và authentication được xử lý qua nhiều clay devices/practices, trong đó information có thể nằm trong counters, sealed containers hoặc các media khác.
historical_change.to: Numerical information ngày càng xuất hiện trực tiếp trên durable clay surfaces, đôi khi cùng authentication marks, trong khi older/parallel practices vẫn tiếp tục chồng lấn.

world.operation: record and authenticate administrative information through several coexisting clay-based practices

primitives.time_scope: Late Uruk, especially the late fourth millennium BCE
primitives.place_scope: Southern Mesopotamia and associated Late-Uruk administrative contexts

world.left: growth in administrative and institutional scale
world.relation: co-occurred with and created pressure compatible with
world.right: greater demand for records and authentication
world.qualification: co-occurrence does not establish a sole cause or one-way causal sequence

primitives.place_scope: Urban and institutional contexts in southern Mesopotamia represented in the approved sources

world.object: broken clay envelope OIM A64678 from Chogha Mish
permits: enclose small clay counters/tokens inside a hollow clay shell
carries: clay tokens still surviving inside the broken shell

world.object: sealed numerical-tablet fragment ChM III-937a from Chogha Mish
permits: carry numerical information directly as signs on a clay surface
carries: several animal seal rollings including a bull

world.operation: shape damp clay and press or incise marks before the clay dries
world.result: numerical impressions or incised marks remain on the clay surface

primitives.place_scope: Southern Mesopotamia and related Late-Uruk recording contexts

world.dimension: physical placement and inspectability of numerical information
world.earlier_state: quantities and authentication were handled across several coexisting physical devices and clay practices
world.later_state: numerical information increasingly appeared directly on durable clay surfaces, sometimes alongside authentication marks
world.coexistence: older and parallel clay practices continued to overlap with direct surface recording
world.qualification: the shift does not identify one invention event or an immediate complete replacement

primitives.time_scope: Late Uruk, late fourth millennium BCE
primitives.place_scope: Southern Mesopotamia and related Late-Uruk administrative contexts

boundaries.rule: Parallel practices must not be converted into a single mandatory developmental sequence.
Administration is a major formation pressure, not a monocausal explanation.
This specimen does not identify a transaction, operator, motive or universal bulla function.
Do not treat it as an earlier step in a direct sequence leading to ChM III-937a.
The object does not identify the recorded commodity, transaction, operator or complete reading of the numerals.
Sharing a site and broad period with OIM A64678 does not establish a direct sequence or shared transaction type.
This is a manufacture/action reconstruction from object traces, not a witnessed event.
Do not invent a named person, motive, dialogue, emotion or specific transaction.
Increasing direct surface recording does not imply immediate or complete replacement of other clay practices.
Do not convert overlapping clay practices into a direct token-to-tablet replacement genealogy.
Do not turn administrative pressure or institutional co-occurrence into a sole-cause or one-way causal verdict.
Do not label a specific economic mechanism such as market exchange, tax, tribute, redistribution, labor obligation or ownership unless independent transaction evidence supports it.

writer_contract: Historical Substrate is the primary model of historical reality. Evidence lookup is secondary and only verifies, sharpens or qualifies details needed by a telling already chosen from this model.
